backup_vault.description: Required. Backup vault where the backups gets stored using this Backup plan.
backup_vault.rationale: Choosing the wrong vault can affect retention enforcement, immutability, access boundaries, and compliance requirements
backup_vault.compliant: approved production backup vault in the designated region

resource_type.description: Required. The resource type to which the `BackupPlan` will be applied. Examples include, "compute.googleapis.com/Instance", "compute.googleapis.com/Disk", "sqladmin.googleapis.com/Instance" and "storage.googleapis.com/Bucket".
resource_type.rationale: An incorrect resource type can make the plan unusable for the intended workload or lead to misconfigured protection

backup_rules.description: Required. The backup rules for this `BackupPlan`. There must be at least one `BackupRule` message.
backup_rules.rationale: Proper backup rules may help to protect data and configurations from loss or corruption.

rule_id.description: Required. The unique ID of this `BackupRule`. The `rule_id` is unique per `BackupPlan`.
rule_id.rationale: This is a identifier only and does not impact security controls for this service.

backup_retention_days.description: Required. Configures the duration for which backup data will be kept. Retention_days must be between 7 and 365 days
backup_retention_days.rationale: Lower period of retention increases data loss and compliance risk.

standard_schedule.description: Required. Standard schedule for taking backups. Structure is [documented below](#nested_backup_rules_backup_rules_standard_schedule).
standard_schedule.rationale: Security rules apply to fields inside this block, not the block itself.

recurrence_type.description: Required. Configures the duration for which backup data will be kept. Recurrence type should be DAILY or WEEKLY
recurrence_type.rationale: Frequency period impacts recovery and compliance. Values outside the approved range increase data loss and compliance risk.

hourly_frequency.description: Required. Specifies frequency for hourly backups. An hourly frequency of 2 means jobs will run every 2 hours from start time till end time defined. This is required for `recurrence_type`, `HOURLY` and is not applicable otherwise.
hourly_frequency.rationale: Backups are configured to run at specified intervals (daily & weekly).

days_of_week.description: Required. Specifies days of week like MONDAY or TUESDAY, on which jobs will run. This is required for `recurrence_type`, `WEEKLY` and is not applicable otherwise. Each value may be one of: `DAY_OF_WEEK_UNSPECIFIED`, `MONDAY`, `TUESDAY`, `WEDNESDAY`, `THURSDAY`, `FRIDAY`, `SATURDAY`, `SUNDAY`.
days_of_week.rationale: Backups are configured to run at specified intervals (daily & weekly)

days_of_month.description: Required. Specifies days of months like 1, 5, or 14 on which jobs will run.
days_of_month.rationale: Backups are configured to run at specified intervals (daily & weekly)

week_day_of_month.description: Required. Specifies a week day of the month like FIRST SUNDAY or LAST MONDAY, on which jobs will run. Structure is [documented below](#nested_backup_rules_backup_rules_standard_schedule_week_day_of_month).
week_day_of_month.rationale: Backups are configured to run at specified intervals (daily & weekly)

months.description: Required. Specifies values of months Each value may be one of: `MONTH_UNSPECIFIED`, `JANUARY`, `FEBRUARY`, `MARCH`, `APRIL`, `MAY`, `JUNE`, `JULY`, `AUGUST`, `SEPTEMBER`, `OCTOBER`, `NOVEMBER`, `DECEMBER`.
months.rationale: Backups are configured to run at specified intervals (daily & weekly)

time_zone.description: Required. The time zone to be used when interpreting the schedule.
time_zone.rationale: An incorrect time zone can cause backups to run outside intended windows, potentially impacting recovery objectives.

backup_window.description: Required. A BackupWindow defines the window of the day during which backup jobs will run. Jobs are queued at the beginning of the window and will be marked as `NOT_RUN` if they do not start by the end of the window.)
backup_window.rationale: Improper backup windows may prevent backups from running successfully.

start_hour_of_day.description: Required. The hour of the day (0-23) when the window starts.
start_hour_of_day.rationale: Backup timing directly affects whether scheduled backups run successfully within the defined window.

end_hour_of_day.description: Required. The hour of the day (1-24) when the window ends.
end_hour_of_day.rationale: Backup timing directly affects whether scheduled backups run successfully within the defined window.

location.description: Required. The GCP location for the backup vault should be on approved region.
location.rationale: Location determines physical hosting region and data residency.

backup_plan_id.description: Required. The ID of the backup plan
backup_plan_id.rationale: Plan ID has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

description.description: The description allows for additional details about `BackupPlan` and its use cases to be provided.
description.rationale: Description has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

log_retention_days.description: This is only applicable for CloudSql resource. Days for which logs will be stored. This value should be greater than or equal to minimum enforced log retention duration of the backup vault.
log_retention_days.rationale: Log retention is a configuration setting and does not directly impact security.

project.description: The number of days backup-related logs are retained.
project.rationale: Insufficient log retention may prevent audits and incident investigation.
